feature: The Measure mode hint fits one short line and never covers the legend
summary: Switching Measure modes still raises the glass pill naming the mode, but every line is now one short sentence and all four fade on the same two-second clock. The [ and ] tip moved to a caption under the Mode control in the inspector, where it stays. The roles legend keeps out of the pill's slot and the tool bar, so on a narrow window it no longer disappears behind either.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. Flags are on by default. Open any screenshot and show the inspector (the sidebar button top right).

try.do: Press I, then press I three more times, pausing a second between presses. Read each pill above the tool bar.
Time one: every pill should be gone about two seconds after the press, Size no later than Distance.
Put the inspector in Size mode (press I until the Mode field reads Size). A grey line under the Mode control should say what [ and ] do.
Switch to Distance in the inspector. The line under Mode should leave, and the field should not jump around.
Hover the Mode control for its tooltip. It should name I and, for Size, the [ and ] keys.
Make the window about 700 points wide, zoom to 100%, and add a Size, a Gap and an Alignment measurement across the top of the picture.
Press I. The legend should stay in a top corner, over a measurement if it must, never behind the tool bar or under the pill.

evaluate: Do the four lines read as one family now, or does Distance's three-click line still feel longer than the rest?
Is 'Click twice, then click to place the number' clear about the third click, or does it read as two clicks total?
Is a caption under the Mode control the right home for the [ and ] keys, or would you expect it on the canvas pill in Size mode?
On a narrow window, is the legend covering a measurement better than the legend stepping down into the pill's slot?
rough: When every corner is taken on a narrow canvas the legend now sits on top of a measurement in the top left rather than behind the bar. Filed as a follow-up: a compact one-row legend or an edge slot would keep it off both.

The pill's slot is reserved even while no pill is up, so on a canvas narrower than about 830 points with three legend rows the bottom corners are never used. Chosen on purpose: a legend that jumps every time you press I would be worse than one that stays put.
The legend was already able to land behind the tool bar on a narrow canvas before this task (the bar is drawn last and wins). Blocking the bar's measured width fixes that too; it is the same walk.

The renders here are offscreen: the pills and the inspector field are drawn with a material stand-in for the glass, and the narrow-window picture is a layer render of the real app in which the glass and the inspector panel do not draw. Placement, text and timing were checked on the running probe app.
Shared code: Current's first-run line now reads 'Click twice, then click to place the number' as well. Its behaviour (stays until the first measurement lands) is unchanged.
